changed: Tapping a control on a phone or tablet no longer raises a tooltip describing the thing you just pressed.
On a touchscreen, scrolling now closes an open menu instead of leaving it parked over the list.
The lit Worn and Consumable marks and the selected view tab sit a shade lighter, and stay readable on a row you're dragging or a group row.
The Worn and Consumable switches are a filled track rather than an outlined one, and easier to see when off.
The message that appears when you remove something is a little rounder at the corners.
fixed: A weight or amount you'd just typed is no longer lost when you press a control on the same row.
In recent changes, the time of a change stays on one line beside a long description.
